authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4287 godhūma gives Kalasha ghöm, Palula ghōm, Torwali ghomū and Hindi gehū̃ wheat. The survey xūm/ghom/gāmo/gehõ variants fit the documented wheat family. Reviewed comparator: Bshk gā̃m “wheat” (f_zuzghgvb5uoag). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10511 yuṣmad explicitly gives northern plural tha/twa and Nepali timi alongside tumhē/tum. Only the clearly plural northern survey forms are selected here; singular thū and short oblique forms require tuvam/tumham paradigm comparison. Reviewed comparator: Bshk tʰā “you (plural)” (f_krv2y2nwtv4pm). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
